S.FORM: e kakhayza'an saksaka SaiSiyat 'ima haSa' tnon.
S.PHON: ə kakhaj[z|ð]aʔan [s|θ]ak[s|θ]aka ʃaiʃijat ʔima haʃaʔ tnon
S.FORM: e kakhayza'an saksaka SaiSiyat 'ima haSa' tnon.
S.PHON: ə kakhaj[z|ð]aʔan [s|θ]ak[s|θ]aka ʃaiʃijat ʔima haʃaʔ tnon
S.TRANSL: 從前賽夏人不會(用竹架子?)織布.
The SaiSiyat people did not know how to weave before.

FORM.notes: source note: 'obay mina rima' 'oemalep 'Obay是要去打獵; mina sa 也可以 | source note: Note: Obay is going hunting; mina sa is also acceptable.

S.FORM: koSa'en tnon ka kaybaeen mina noka a biwa' sa ina toertoeroe'.
S.PHON: koʃaʔən tnon ka kajβæən mina noka a βiwaʔ [s|θ]a ina tœrtœrœʔ
S.FORM: koSa'en tnon ka kaybaeen mina noka a biwa' sa ina toertoeroe'.
S.PHON: koʃaʔən tnon ka kajβæən mina noka a βiwaʔ [s|θ]a ina tœrtœrœʔ
S.TRANSL: 據說織衣服是以前雷神教的.
It was Kathethel who taught (them) weaving.

S.FORM: biwa' 'inay rayno' mwai' kakhayzaehan sa.
S.PHON: βiwaʔ ʔinaj rajnoʔ mwaiʔ kakhaj[z|ð]æhan [s|θ]a
S.FORM: biwa' 'inay rayno' mwai' kakhayzaehan sa.
S.PHON: βiwaʔ ʔinaj rajnoʔ mwaiʔ kakhaj[z|ð]æhan [s|θ]a
S.TRANSL: 為此雷神從哪兒來呢?
Where does Kathethel come from?

S.FORM: koSa'en SaiSiya rima' kama'alep rima' ray 'oeS'oeSoe'an.
S.PHON: koʃaʔən ʃaiʃija rimaʔ kamaʔaləp rimaʔ raj ʔœʃʔœʃœʔan
S.FORM: koSa'en SaiSiya rima' kama'alep rima' ray 'oeS'oeSoe'an.
S.PHON: koʃaʔən ʃaiʃija rimaʔ kamaʔaləp rimaʔ raj ʔœʃʔœʃœʔan
S.TRANSL: 據說賽夏人去 ... ... 獵人去山上.
The SaiSiyats go hunting in the woods.

S.FORM: lam lampez mae'iyaeh rima' 'alep ila 'aehae' hahila rima' 'alep.
S.PHON: lam lampə[z|ð] mæʔijæh rimaʔ ʔaləp ila ʔæhæʔ hahila rimaʔ ʔaləp
S.FORM: lam lampez mae'iyaeh rima' 'alep ila 'aehae' hahila rima' 'alep.
S.PHON: lam lampə[z|ð] mæʔijæh rimaʔ ʔaləp ila ʔæhæʔ hahila rimaʔ ʔaləp
S.TRANSL: 有十個人去打一整天的獵.
Ten persons went hunting. The hunt lasted for one day.

S.FORM: lobihin kita'en ray 'inasal ka a pazay ray koloban ma' sizaeh ila talek.
S.PHON: loβihin kitaʔən raj ʔina[s|θ]al ka a pa[z|ð]aj raj koloβan maʔ [s|θ]i[z|ð]æh ila talək
S.FORM: lobihin kita'en ray 'inasal ka a pazay ray koloban ma' sizaeh ila talek.
S.PHON: loβihin kitaʔən raj ʔina[s|θ]al ka a pa[z|ð]aj raj koloβan maʔ [s|θ]i[z|ð]æh ila talək
S.TRANSL: 回到工寮(沒有人),卻看見鍋子裡有飯 ... ... 在鍋子裡也有燒好的飯.
Upon their return, they saw the rice in the pot has been cooked.

S.FORM: XXXX koSa ma' hini hiya' mwai' talek ray isason ka ka pazay hini.
S.PHON: **** koʃa maʔ hini hijaʔ mwaiʔ talək raj i[s|θ]a[s|θ]on ka ka pa[z|ð]aj hini
S.FORM: XXXX koSa ma' hini hiya' mwai' talek ray isason ka ka pazay hini.
S.PHON: **** koʃa maʔ hini hijaʔ mwaiʔ talək raj i[s|θ]a[s|θ]on ka ka pa[z|ð]aj hini
S.TRANSL: 就是說這個 ... ... 誰來到山上來煮這頓飯呢?
Who came to cook the rice?

FORM.notes: source note: Note 1 : A: hayza ay ka ralom ray ba:la? | source note: B:'iya ralom | source note: A: 河裡面有水嗎? | source note: B: 有水 | source note: A: Is there water in the river? | source note: B: There is water. | source note: Note 2: 'obay Somarak ka 'iyaralomon | source note: Obay 掉到有水的地方 | source note: Obay fell into a place filed with water. | source note: Note 3: Ni 'obay hi 'ataw ka 'oeboes 'iyaralomon | source note: Ataw 的口袋被 Obay 裝水 | source note: Obay filled Ataw's pocket with water.

S.FORM: lasia ray 'inasal ma' 'al'alihan bala' 'iyaralomon.
S.PHON: la[s|θ]ia raj ʔina[s|θ]al maʔ ʔalʔalihan βalaʔ ʔijaralomon
S.FORM: lasia ray 'inasal ma' 'al'alihan bala' 'iyaralomon.
S.PHON: la[s|θ]ia raj ʔina[s|θ]al maʔ ʔalʔalihan βalaʔ ʔijaralomon
S.TRANSL: 他們在工寮裡,很接近河川.
Their workplace is close to the river.

FORM.notes: source note: ka-kita' 注意看 互相看 look at each other | source note: IU#22 hini 可用 rini; IU#22 rini is acceptable | source note: ya:o miyalawa' hi 'obay 我監視 'Obay; I am checking on 'Obay

S.FORM: ka koSa'en kakita' So 'aehae' hahila kil 'aehae' hahila rim'an ila tatini' So'o 'aehae' honay hini 'iyalawa' kitkita' hiya' 'atomal mwai' ma' talek ka pazay 'inimita' isaa kama'alep haebaeaen rima' ila.
S.PHON: ka koʃaʔən kakitaʔ ʃo ʔæhæʔ hahila kil ʔæhæʔ hahila rimʔan ila tatiniʔ ʃoʔo ʔæhæʔ honaj hini ʔijalawaʔ kitkitaʔ hijaʔ ʔatomal mwaiʔ maʔ talək ka pa[z|ð]aj ʔinimitaʔ i[s|θ]aa kamaʔaləp hæβææn rimaʔ ila
S.FORM: ka koSa'en kakita' So 'aehae' hahila kil 'aehae' hahila rim'an ila tatini' So'o 'aehae' honay hini 'iyalawa' kitkita' hiya' 'atomal mwai' ma' talek ka pazay 'inimita' isaa kama'alep haebaeaen rima' ila.
S.PHON: ka koʃaʔən kakitaʔ ʃo ʔæhæʔ hahila kil ʔæhæʔ hahila rimʔan ila tatiniʔ ʃoʔo ʔæhæʔ honaj hini ʔijalawaʔ kitkitaʔ hijaʔ ʔatomal mwaiʔ maʔ talək ka pa[z|ð]aj ʔinimitaʔ i[s|θ]aa kamaʔaləp hæβææn rimaʔ ila
S.TRANSL: 讓一個老人在這裡站崗,看看到底是誰來給獵人煮飯.
One of the elders was left to guard the place and watch who would come to cook the rice. The hunters left.

S.FORM: 'aehae' tatini' e pakitkita'en ri'sa isa 'aehae' 'ima roehaenaen ila sa'oewaz kita'en 'inaray waSal 'inaray ralom mwai' kakamehoera ka kabinao' 'al'alak 'atomal mwai' 'isaa rima' kita'en sa talek ila.
S.PHON: ʔæhæʔ tatiniʔ ə pakitkitaʔən riʔ[s|θ]a i[s|θ]a ʔæhæʔ ʔima rœhænæn ila [s|θ]aʔœwa[z|ð] kitaʔən ʔinaraj waʃal ʔinaraj ralom mwaiʔ kakaməhœra ka kaβinaoʔ ʔalʔalak ʔatomal mwaiʔ ʔi[s|θ]aa rimaʔ kitaʔən [s|θ]a talək ila
S.FORM: 'aehae' tatini' e pakitkita'en ri'sa isa 'aehae' 'ima roehaenaen ila sa'oewaz kita'en 'inaray waSal 'inaray ralom mwai' kakamehoera ka kabinao' 'al'alak 'atomal mwai' 'isaa rima' kita'en sa talek ila.
S.PHON: ʔæhæʔ tatiniʔ ə pakitkitaʔən riʔ[s|θ]a i[s|θ]a ʔæhæʔ ʔima rœhænæn ila [s|θ]aʔœwa[z|ð] kitaʔən ʔinaraj waʃal ʔinaraj ralom mwaiʔ kakaməhœra ka kaβinaoʔ ʔalʔalak ʔatomal mwaiʔ ʔi[s|θ]aa rimaʔ kitaʔən [s|θ]a talək ila
S.TRANSL: 晚上的時候,果真看到一位非常年輕的女子,一下子從海 ... ... 從水裡出來,走來走去燒飯.
In the evening, the elder saw a very young lady come out from the sea and saw her cook.

FORM.notes: source note: minaSoka' hi 'obay 'am lobih ila taew'an Obay準備要回去了嗎? Note: Is Obay preparing to go back?

S.FORM: sizaeh ila talek mina Soka' 'am lobih ilahao 'am raiw ila.
S.PHON: [s|θ]i[z|ð]æh ila talək mina ʃokaʔ ʔam loβih ilahao ʔam raiw ila
S.FORM: sizaeh ila talek mina Soka' 'am lobih ilahao 'am raiw ila.
S.PHON: [s|θ]i[z|ð]æh ila talək mina ʃokaʔ ʔam loβih ilahao ʔam raiw ila
S.TRANSL: (那位女子)煮完了,準備要跑回去時.
When the lady finished cooking, she prepared to leave.

FORM.notes: source note: source question-mark transcription represented as UNCLEAR

S.FORM: noka 'isaa noka baki' sipoti' noka hobak 'isaa 'oka' ila 'i sipoti' 'oka' ila i sahpiih ka isaa.
S.PHON: noka ʔi[s|θ]aa noka βakiʔ [s|θ]ipotiʔ noka hoβak ʔi[s|θ]aa ʔokaʔ ila ʔi [s|θ]ipotiʔ ʔokaʔ ila i [s|θ]ahpiih ka i[s|θ]aa
S.FORM: noka 'isaa noka baki' sipoti' noka hobak 'isaa 'oka' ila 'i sipoti' 'oka' ila i sahpiih ka isaa.
S.PHON: noka ʔi[s|θ]aa noka βakiʔ [s|θ]ipotiʔ noka hoβak ʔi[s|θ]aa ʔokaʔ ila ʔi [s|θ]ipotiʔ ʔokaʔ ila i [s|θ]ahpiih ka i[s|θ]aa
S.TRANSL: 老人用標槍擋住, (她就)無法通過那個.
The elder blocked her way and she was not able to pass through.

FORM.notes: source note: 'inay 'ino' 哪裡回來 | source note: AF: paehraerang | source note: yao kayngi' maeraehrang ki sia 我不要跟他商量 | source note: yao kayngi' maeraehrang nisia 我不要替他商量 | source note: Note:'inay 'ino' where from? | source note: I don't want to discuss with him. | source note: I don't want to discuss for him.

S.FORM: 'inay risa' isaa paehraehraengen singozawen naehaen mwai' maehraehraeng.
S.PHON: ʔinaj ri[s|θ]aʔ i[s|θ]aa pæhræhræŋən [s|θ]iŋo[z|ð]awən næhæn mwaiʔ mæhræhræŋ
S.FORM: 'inay risa' isaa paehraehraengen singozawen naehaen mwai' maehraehraeng.
S.PHON: ʔinaj ri[s|θ]aʔ i[s|θ]aa pæhræhræŋən [s|θ]iŋo[z|ð]awən næhæn mwaiʔ mæhræhræŋ
S.TRANSL: 老人跟她談話, 問她從哪裡來.
The elder talked to her and asked her where she was from.

S.FORM: nak'ini ila o 'isaa o roehaenaen ila o kama'alep lobih ila.
S.PHON: nakʔini ila o ʔi[s|θ]aa o rœhænæn ila o kamaʔaləp loβih ila
S.FORM: nak'ini ila o 'isaa o roehaenaen ila o kama'alep lobih ila.
S.PHON: nakʔini ila o ʔi[s|θ]aa o rœhænæn ila o kamaʔaləp loβih ila
S.TRANSL: 那天晚上,獵人回來了.
At night, the hunters returned home.

S.FORM: 'aehae' ka 'aehoe' minsa'la' mwai' mwai' risaa isaa mwai' wawisawis potngor ila.
S.PHON: ʔæhæʔ ka ʔæhœʔ min[s|θ]aʔlaʔ mwaiʔ mwaiʔ ri[s|θ]aa i[s|θ]aa mwaiʔ wawi[s|θ]awi[s|θ] potŋor ila
S.FORM: 'aehae' ka 'aehoe' minsa'la' mwai' mwai' risaa isaa mwai' wawisawis potngor ila.
S.PHON: ʔæhæʔ ka ʔæhœʔ min[s|θ]aʔlaʔ mwaiʔ mwaiʔ ri[s|θ]aa i[s|θ]aa mwaiʔ wawi[s|θ]awi[s|θ] potŋor ila
S.TRANSL: 狗先來,來到那裡.
The dog arrived home ahead and wagged its tail.

S.FORM: hiza 'aehoe' hiza ma' sebeten sebeten koSa.
S.PHON: hi[z|ð]a ʔæhœʔ hi[z|ð]a maʔ [s|θ]əβətən [s|θ]əβətən koʃa
S.FORM: hiza 'aehoe' hiza ma' sebeten sebeten koSa.
S.PHON: hi[z|ð]a ʔæhœʔ hi[z|ð]a maʔ [s|θ]əβətən [s|θ]əβətən koʃa
S.TRANSL: (獵人)拍拍那條狗,說道:
The hunters patted the dog and said,

FORM.notes: source note: yao 'okik kihngap: 我沒有喘氣 | source note: Note: yao 'okik kihngap: I am not panting

S.FORM: 'ampowa' mwai' kaehngap.
S.PHON: ʔampowaʔ mwaiʔ kæhŋap
S.FORM: 'ampowa' mwai' kaehngap.
S.PHON: ʔampowaʔ mwaiʔ kæhŋap
S.TRANSL: 怎麼這麼喘呢?
What is the matter?

S.FORM: 'toet ka 'aehoe'.
S.PHON: ʔtœt ka ʔæhœʔ
S.FORM: 'toet ka 'aehoe'.
S.PHON: ʔtœt ka ʔæhœʔ
S.TRANSL: 狗(被打到)放屁.
The dog farted.

S.FORM: isaa hiza ka minkoringan sawa' ila sawa ila isaa paehraehraengen ila siwa' ila singsingozawen ila.
S.PHON: i[s|θ]aa hi[z|ð]a ka minkoriŋan [s|θ]awaʔ ila [s|θ]awa ila i[s|θ]aa pæhræhræŋən ila [s|θ]iwaʔ ila [s|θ]iŋ[s|θ]iŋo[z|ð]awən ila
S.FORM: isaa hiza ka minkoringan sawa' ila sawa ila isaa paehraehraengen ila siwa' ila singsingozawen ila.
S.PHON: i[s|θ]aa hi[z|ð]a ka minkoriŋan [s|θ]awaʔ ila [s|θ]awa ila i[s|θ]aa pæhræhræŋən ila [s|θ]iwaʔ ila [s|θ]iŋ[s|θ]iŋo[z|ð]awən ila
S.TRANSL: 那小姑娘笑了.大家跟她商量,她就答應了.
The lady broke out laughing and agreed to talk.

S.FORM: sa nak hini yao hini 'al'alak haysia.
S.PHON: [s|θ]a nak hini jao hini ʔalʔalak haj[s|θ]ia
S.FORM: sa nak hini yao hini 'al'alak haysia.
S.PHON: [s|θ]a nak hini jao hini ʔalʔalak haj[s|θ]ia
S.TRANSL: (她一直問)像我這樣還年輕.
(She kept asking) I am still young.

S.FORM: a yao ni yaba' torongon koSa'en sa'ila ma' toertoroe' ka a tatnon nak hini isaa.
S.PHON: a jao ni jaβaʔ toroŋon koʃaʔən [s|θ]aʔila maʔ tœrtorœʔ ka a tatnon nak hini i[s|θ]aa
S.FORM: a yao ni yaba' torongon koSa'en sa'ila ma' toertoroe' ka a tatnon nak hini isaa.
S.PHON: a jao ni jaβaʔ toroŋon koʃaʔən [s|θ]aʔila maʔ tœrtorœʔ ka a tatnon nak hini i[s|θ]aa
S.TRANSL: 我爸爸叫我去教編織的方法.
My father instructed me to teach people how to weave.

S.FORM: 'oka ila sa' mwai' ila ka imahabaan kama'alep.
S.PHON: ʔoka ila [s|θ]aʔ mwaiʔ ila ka imahaβaan kamaʔaləp
S.FORM: 'oka ila sa' mwai' ila ka imahabaan kama'alep.
S.PHON: ʔoka ila [s|θ]aʔ mwaiʔ ila ka imahaβaan kamaʔaləp
S.TRANSL: 來很多人.
There came more hunters.

S.FORM: mwai' a' papnabih koSa hini kabinao' hayza' ka 'al'alak e pakray'aboe ila lasia.
S.PHON: mwaiʔ aʔ papnaβih koʃa hini kaβinaoʔ haj[z|ð]aʔ ka ʔalʔalak ə pakrajʔaβœ ila la[s|θ]ia
S.FORM: mwai' a' papnabih koSa hini kabinao' hayza' ka 'al'alak e pakray'aboe ila lasia.
S.PHON: mwaiʔ aʔ papnaβih koʃa hini kaβinaoʔ haj[z|ð]aʔ ka ʔalʔalak ə pakrajʔaβœ ila la[s|θ]ia
S.TRANSL: 打獵的人回來,談論說,這個小姐和年輕的男生,要讓他們結婚.
The hunters wanted a young man to marry the young lady.

S.FORM: a 'in'alay isaza siwa' hayza' 'aehae' 'al'alak 'ima 'i'ini' rwasek i isaa lasia pakrwaseken ila.
S.PHON: a ʔinʔalaj i[s|θ]a[z|ð]a [s|θ]iwaʔ haj[z|ð]aʔ ʔæhæʔ ʔalʔalak ʔima ʔiʔiniʔ rwa[s|θ]ək i i[s|θ]aa la[s|θ]ia pakrwa[s|θ]əkən ila
S.TRANSL: 允許他們的婚事.
The young man who has not yet married agreed to get married with her.

S.FORM: isaa rwasek ila isaa hN koza ila kin honahnge hiza ma'.
S.PHON: i[s|θ]aa rwa[s|θ]ək ila i[s|θ]aa hn ko[z|ð]a ila kin honahŋə hi[z|ð]a maʔ
S.FORM: isaa rwasek ila isaa hN koza ila kin honahnge hiza ma'.
S.PHON: i[s|θ]aa rwa[s|θ]ək ila i[s|θ]aa hn ko[z|ð]a ila kin honahŋə hi[z|ð]a maʔ
S.TRANSL: 結婚後過了很久.
It has been a long time after they got married.

S.PHON: ka hi[z|ð]a minkoriŋan ʔam loβih ko[s|θ]a ʔam rimaʔ kala jaβa nahan ni[s|θ]ia rimaʔ raj ʔinkahœlan
S.FORM: ka hiza minkoringan 'am lobih kosa 'am rima' kala yaba nahan nisia rima' ray 'inkahoelan.
S.PHON: ka hi[z|ð]a minkoriŋan ʔam loβih ko[s|θ]a ʔam rimaʔ kala jaβa nahan ni[s|θ]ia rimaʔ raj ʔinkahœlan
S.TRANSL: 結婚後很久,想要回娘家.
After getting married for a long time, the woman asked to go home to her parents' house.

S.FORM: 'am rima' hiza ka 'al'alak rima' oyae ta tanisowaw.
S.PHON: ʔam rimaʔ hi[z|ð]a ka ʔalʔalak rimaʔ ojæ ta tani[s|θ]owaw
S.FORM: 'am rima' hiza ka 'al'alak rima' oyae ta tanisowaw.
S.PHON: ʔam rimaʔ hi[z|ð]a ka ʔalʔalak rimaʔ ojæ ta tani[s|θ]owaw
S.TRANSL: 那個年輕人也要跟著去.
Her husband wanted to go with her.

S.FORM: rima' isaa kita'en sa' haw ray ralom izo' kayzaeh taew'an.
S.PHON: rimaʔ i[s|θ]aa kitaʔən [s|θ]aʔ haw raj ralom i[z|ð]oʔ kaj[z|ð]æh tæwʔan
S.FORM: rima' isaa kita'en sa' haw ray ralom izo' kayzaeh taew'an.
S.PHON: rimaʔ i[s|θ]aa kitaʔən [s|θ]aʔ haw raj ralom i[z|ð]oʔ kaj[z|ð]æh tæwʔan
S.TRANSL: 看到在水裡有很漂亮的家.
They saw her beautiful house under the water.

S.FORM: o toon akoy atomal o XXXX 'ima raam tnon koSa sarara' koSa hini ay 'ima raam tnon.
